_note: Curated conditional buffs (A): weapon passives + artifact 4pc effects, opt-in per build. Values are approximate R1/C0, ~full-uptime. Three effect kinds: `effects` are sheet-additive stats folded into Final Stats; `talentDmgBonuses` are per-hit DMG% that only multiply the scoped talent's damage instances; `resShred` is an enemy RES debuff applied in the damage calc. Two shreds sharing a `source` are the same in-game effect via different routes (a VV teammate vs. this build's own VV 4pc) and take the max instead of stacking. Each entry declares its unlock (weaponId / setId+minPieces).
